configurePresets.description: Debug FDA build: the one preset is linked in at the end of the application slot (pages 124-125, Core/Inc/presets/fda_preset.h from the SDK's generate_presets.py); it and the user config are read-only, firmware programs the TX7332 chips and host register writes are refused. Runs under the bootloader whose slot is pages 32-125.

Runs under the bootloader whose slot is pages 32-125.
